controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM .internal.alerts-security.alerts-default-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-12T19:40:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T20:40:00.000Z"
        AND host.name == "web-2"
        AND kibana.alert.rule.rule_id == "v2-sshd-success-after-failures"
| KEEP @timestamp, kibana.alert.rule.name, kibana.alert.reason, message, kibana.alert.ancestors.id, kibana.alert.ancestors.index, kibana.alert.ancestors.depth
| SORT @timestamp ASC
| LIMIT 5
